examples.text: Eine sehr kleine Menge dieser Flüssigkeit genügt, um einen Menschen zu betäuben und wehrlos zu machen.
examples.translation: Une très petite quantité de ce liquide suffit à étourdir une personne et à la rendre sans défense.

examples.text: Man kann die ganze Reuß-Verschwörung natürlich als totalen Unsinn abtun. (...) Oder die Erzählung, dass mächtige Politiker wehrlose Kinder in unterirdischen Bunkern gefangen halten, um aus ihrem Blut einen Verjüngungstrank zu brauen, ein altes antisemitisches Narrativ.
examples.translation: On peut bien sûr considérer toute la conspiration de prince Reuß comme une absurdité totale. (...) Ou encore le récit selon lequel des politiciens puissants emprisonnent des enfants sans défense dans des bunkers souterrains afin de préparer une potion de rajeunissement à partir de leur sang, un vieux récit antisémite.

glosses: Lacking any form of defense; vulnerable; open to attack.

examples.text: Her look, her attitude, her words were eloquent of the age-old appeal of defenseless woman to her natural protector—man.

On the port tack layline , you're defenseless against starboard tackers — you have to dip them , no matter how much you may lose doing it — and the wind shadow of boats spinnakering away from the mark can cost you plenty.

glosses: More or most likely to be exposed to the chance of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.

examples.text: In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave me some advice that I’ve been turning over in my mind ever since. ‘Whenever you feel like criticizing any one,’ he told me, ‘just remember that all the people in this world haven’t had the advantages that you’ve had.’
The elimination of [Roger] Federer after [Rafael] Nadal's loss to Lukas Rosol would have created mild panic among the fans of these gloriously gifted but now clearly vulnerable geniuses.
